rows.label: qst202205_0010
rows.name: Raiko! We finally caught up with you.

rows.label: qst202205_0020
rows.name:
Please, don't come near me, okay?
I can't control my own power.

rows.label: qst202205_0030
rows.name: That's why I'll end up shocking everyone...

rows.label: qst202205_0040
rows.name:
That's as may be, but
don't worry about it.

rows.label: qst202205_0050
rows.name: Your power is a massive help to us!

rows.label: qst202205_0060
rows.name: Yeah. I really don't mind.

rows.label: qst202205_0070
rows.name: R-really?

rows.label: qst202205_0080
rows.name: It's true.

rows.label: qst202205_0090
rows.name:
You still have much growing to do.
Perhaps a little training is in order?

rows.label: qst202205_0100
rows.name: Training?

rows.label: qst202205_0110
rows.name: That's a great idea, mo.

rows.label: qst202205_0120
rows.name:
Raiko-san, if you face your own power,
you may get better at controlling lightning.

rows.label: qst202205_0130
rows.name:
Then you won't accidentally shock anyone,
and...

rows.label: qst202205_0140
rows.name: Then no one will have to feel sad.

rows.label: qst202205_0150
rows.name: Then I won't have to get shocked either.

rows.label: qst202205_0160
rows.name: I see... You're right.

rows.label: qst202205_0170
rows.name: Thank you all for the great advice.

rows.label: qst202205_0180
rows.name:
I'll work hard at my training.
I'll definitely learn to control it.

rows.label: qst202205_0190
rows.name: Please keep looking out for me!

rows.label: qst202205_0200
rows.name: S-Stoooop!
